signals.name: maxDepth
signals.quantity: maximum recursion depth of MessageUnpacker.unpackValue() during one execution
signals.reset: V1Guidance.getInput() calls V1Counters.reset() before each execution

plans.retention: Primary: retain input if maxDepth > bestMaxDepth. Secondary (while signal is flat): retain inputs that are longer (growing toward input_bytes=6301) or that contain container format bytes (0x91, 0x81, 0xDD, 0xDC), so the search can cross the threshold where parsing succeeds and recursion begins.
mutation: Byte-level: random byte flip, random byte insert, random byte delete, block copy/shuffle

Repetition [R45a]: duplicate a contiguous run of bytes (preferring container bytes 0x91) and repeat k times in place, with k up to filling MAX_INPUT_SIZE (10240). From a seed of a few 0x91+0xC0 bytes, repeated doubling reaches 6301 bytes in ~12 steps (< 1 minute).

Dictionary [R45b]: tokens from the source on the attack path: {0x91} fixarray(1), {0x81} fixmap(1), {0xC0} nil, {0xC2} false, {0xC3} true, {0xDD} ARRAY32, {0xDC} ARRAY16, {0xDF} MAP32, {0x00} fixint-0. Inserted or overwritten at random positions.
No encoder needed [R45c]: msgpack container+terminal bytes are accepted raw; no checksums, compression, or length-prefix encoding to pass.

signals.name: declaredArraySize
signals.quantity: element count declared in the first ARRAY/MAP header of the input, which is the exact argument to new Value[size] at the sink
signals.read: V2Guidance.handleResult() parses the input bytes for ARRAY32/ARRAY16/fixarray/MAP32/MAP16/fixmap header and extracts the declared size

plans.retention: Primary: retain input if declaredArraySize > bestDeclaredSize. Secondary (while signal is 0, i.e. no valid array/map header found): retain inputs that contain array/map format bytes (0x90-0x9F, 0xDC, 0xDD, 0x80-0x8F, 0xDE, 0xDF) and that are at least 5 bytes long (enough for ARRAY32 header).
mutation: Byte-level: random byte flip, random byte insert, random byte delete
Repetition [R45a]: copy a chunk and repeat it k times to grow the input; not the primary growth mechanism for this target but ensures diverse inputs.

Dictionary [R45b]: tokens from the source: {0xDD} ARRAY32, {0xDC} ARRAY16, {0x91} fixarray(1), {0x9F} fixarray(15), {0xDF} MAP32, {0xDE} MAP16, {0xC0} nil, {0xFF} max-byte, {0x7F} max-positive-byte. Inserted at random positions.

Size-field targeted mutation: when input starts with 0xDD (ARRAY32), mutate bytes at offsets 1-4 specifically toward larger values (set to 0xFF, increment, randomize high bytes while keeping positive).
No encoder needed [R45c]: msgpack headers are bare bytes, no checksums or compression.

signals.name: declaredPayloadBytes
signals.quantity: payload length declared in the first BIN/EXT header of the input, which is the exact argument to new byte[length] at the sink
signals.read: V3Guidance.handleResult() parses the input bytes for BIN32/BIN16/BIN8/EXT32/EXT16/EXT8 header and extracts the declared length

plans.retention: Primary: retain input if declaredPayloadBytes > bestDeclaredLength. Secondary (while signal is 0, i.e. no valid binary/ext header found): retain inputs that contain BIN/EXT format bytes (0xC4-0xC9) and that are at least 5 bytes long (enough for BIN32 header).
mutation: Byte-level: random byte flip, random byte insert, random byte delete
Repetition [R45a]: copy a chunk and repeat it k times to grow the input.

Dictionary [R45b]: tokens from the source: {0xC6} BIN32, {0xC9} EXT32, {0xC4} BIN8, {0xC5} BIN16, {0xC7} EXT8, {0xC8} EXT16, {0xC0} nil, {0xFF} max-byte, {0x7F} max-positive-byte. Inserted at random positions.
Length-field targeted mutation: when input starts with 0xC6 (BIN32) or 0xC9 (EXT32), mutate bytes at offsets 1-4 specifically toward larger values.
No encoder needed [R45c]: msgpack headers are bare bytes.
